hero.headline: Innovative Chemical Admixtures for Modern Concrete
hero.subtext: We develop and supply high-performance admixtures for aerated and ready-mix concrete, and provide professional testing services for building materials.

services.heading: What do we do?
services.description: From chemical admixtures and raw materials to laboratory testing and production consulting — we cover every stage of modern concrete manufacturing.

labTests.title: Laboratory Tests

audit.title: Audit

admixtures.title: Admixtures
admixtures.description: High-performance chemical admixtures for aerated and ready-mix concrete tailored to your production needs.

productionTechnology.title: Production Technology
productionTechnology.description: Technical consulting and process optimization for modern concrete manufacturing and aerated concrete plants.

machinery.title: Machinery

whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are?
whoWeAre.text: We are an experienced team of specialists with over 10 years of experience in the concrete chemical admixtures and construction laboratories industry. We represent youth, creativity, and openness to innovation. Our achievements in creating innovative products for concrete, including chemical admixtures, and conducting research in our construction laboratory, constitute the foundation of our activity. We stand out in the market thanks to our passion, full commitment, and constant pursuit of improving our products and services.

admixtures.heading: Why are our chemical admixtures for concrete the best choice?
admixtures.description: If you are looking for effective and economical chemical admixtures for concrete, our company is the answer to your needs. We specialize in offering a new generation of lignosulfonate-based admixtures that guarantee higher quality concrete at competitive prices. Whether you need admixtures in liquid or solid form, our experienced team of specialists will tailor them to your expectations.

card.title: Individual Approach
card.description: For each client, admixtures are selected and composed to precisely match their specific requirements.

labTests.heading: Laboratory tests of building materials
labTests.description: We collect samples of building materials regardless of location and transfer them to our advanced construction laboratory. As an expert in the field of materials testing and analysis, we offer aggregate manufacturers support not only in terms of Factory Production Control but also in preparing professional commercial documentation.

card.title: Professional measuring equipment
card.description: We have modern measuring equipment that meets all technical standards and norms.
